title: Understand or investigate
when: Map a project, follow behavior, or investigate an external question.

choices.when: Need a repository overview, relevant files, conventions, and commands before work; inspect without running project code.
Need to explain one existing behavior by following its trigger, calls, data effects, and outcome.
Need external primary-source evidence or a comparison, beyond mapping local code.

title: Define behavior or plan work
when: Decide what to build, settle rules, plan implementation, or preserve settled work.

choices.when: Prepare a proposal for another party to assess, preserving domain context, evidence, desired outcomes, and unknowns; drafting does not submit or implement it.
An idea or rough notes need product behavior, user roles, scope, journeys, and acceptance criteria; what to build is still being defined.
Ambiguous business terms or conflicting rules block a decision; clarify their meaning with concrete scenarios.
Design or review a consumer-facing API contract, including compatibility, errors, retries, and versioning.
Need an implementation approach, work order, dependencies, and verification for the requested behavior; do not regenerate settled requirements.
Compare UI directions or resolve a state/business-rule question through an isolated interactive prototype.
Explicitly asked to register settled tasks or preserve a plan as a local checklist.
Prepare or resume another session with decisions, progress, and context that the repository alone cannot recover.

title: Implement or fix
when: Change code, diagnose bugs or CI, upgrade dependencies, migrate data, or optimize.

choices.when: Implement an authorized feature or refactor; use a narrower workflow when it already covers the requested change.
A reported bug or failing command needs reproduction, cause analysis, a scoped fix, and regression checks.
An identified revision or pull request has failing CI that needs diagnosis and correction.
Install a requested package/runtime upgrade or remediation, including compatible manifest and lockfile changes.
Prepare, review, or run a schema change or data backfill with compatibility and recovery; live execution needs its identified target and authorization.
Improve a demonstrated code bottleneck and compare matched before/after results; measurement alone does not authorize changes.

title: Review or assess readiness
when: Find defects, review and fix, assess a dependency or skill, or prepare human review.

choices.when: Investigate a received proposal, independently check its claims, assess related problems and impact, and recommend a justified decision; detailed plans when requested, no implementation.
Review selected code changes for defects or recorded decision compliance and report findings without edits.
Review and fix confirmed defects iteratively within the authorized scope, then recheck affected behavior.
Review specified code/configuration for exploitable security defects with attacker control and trust-boundary evidence.
Assess adopting or changing a dependency for fit, maintenance, footprint, compatibility, and advisories; no installation.
Assess Agent Skill discovery, decision rules, standalone resources, and evaluation evidence; review alone makes no edits.
Prepare a feature-grouped reading order and risk map for a human reviewer, without a defect verdict.
Assess completion and commit readiness from existing evidence; do not start new implementation or checks.
Review a work session for observed process friction and propose improvements; do not change code or settings.

title: Verify, test, or prepare release
when: Run checks, choose or write tests, measure performance, or prepare QA and rollout.

choices.when: Choose and execute suitable checks for a change and report actual results and unchecked scope.
Assess coverage gaps or choose meaningful test cases and boundaries; specialized test work can use the matching choice below directly.
Add focused checks for calculations, decisions, and state transitions without real infrastructure.
Check real dependency boundaries, persistence, serialization, or adapter wiring.
Check compatibility between consumers and providers of APIs, messages, or serialized data.
Check a critical journey through the actual app or CLI to observable completion.
Check justified invariants across generated inputs or state transitions with reproducible failures.
Improve an existing suite's redundancy, brittleness, flakiness, or cost while retaining meaningful detection.
Measure performance or compare baseline and candidate under matched workloads; optimization is a separate change request.
Prepare manual verification steps with preconditions, actions, and expected results; writing steps does not execute them.
Identify deployment prerequisites and before/during/after rollout actions; do not deploy.

title: Operate Git
when: Manage ignore rules, branches, commits, conflicts, synchronization, worktrees, or pull requests.

choices.when: Inspect, create, switch, rename, or delete an identified local branch.
Create, review, debug, or simplify Git ignore rules, including scope, overlapping patterns, and exceptions; untracking and deletion are separate actions.
Inspect staging/commit hygiene, stage or split changes, or draft a commit message within the requested scope.
Resolve existing merge, rebase, or cherry-pick conflicts and continue the authorized operation.
Fetch, pull, push, or check ahead/behind/diverged state for an identified branch.
Create, inspect, remove, or maintain requested worktrees for parallel work.
Draft, create, or update a GitHub pull request title/description; review code through a review workflow.

title: Write, edit, or shape an answer
when: Draft or revise prose, summarize sources, or apply requested language and delivery guidance.

choices.when: Draft new reader-facing prose from a brief or evidence; choose a more specific document workflow when it fits.
Revise existing prose for clarity and voice while preserving its meaning and qualifications.
Compress a specified document, thread, transcript, or text faithfully.
Create, revise, or review a package README for consumers, including installation and first use.
Create, revise, or review developer guides, API references, examples, or documentation structure.
The deliverable is Korean reader-facing prose needing language guidance; Korean conversation alone is not a trigger.
The deliverable is English reader-facing prose needing language guidance; English conversation alone is not a trigger.
Asked for a scannable status, progress, or handover briefing; it does not replace the underlying task.
Asked for readable, answer-first explanations for ADHD or limited attention; keep essential depth.
Asked for blunt, terse conversation; brevity does not reduce authorized work or essential conditions.

title: Design or inspect an interface
when: Handle visual hierarchy, responsive behavior, accessibility, mobile browsers, or UI content extremes.

choices.when: Create, revise, or review interface composition, hierarchy, components, and meaningful states around actual tasks and content.
Layout fails across widths, content sizes, or zoom: diagnose reflow, overflow, stacking, and access.
Touch/hover, scrolling, viewport, safe-area, or on-screen keyboard behavior breaks in a mobile browser or PWA.
Implement or review semantics, keyboard operation, focus, perceivable states, contrast, or enlargement.
Choose components or a library for a concrete frontend capability gap; preserve project and explicit user choices.
Exercise realistic content extremes, missing data, localization, and state boundaries through existing UI fixtures or previews.

title: Build or investigate motion
when: Name, implement, debug, review, or measure web and native animation.

choices.when: Implement web transitions, gestures, drawers, and feedback with project-compatible tools.
Implement React Native or Expo gestures, transitions, sheets, keyboard motion, or optional haptics.
Diagnose and fix a concrete animation jump, flicker, delay, or interruption failure.
Measure and improve demonstrated frame pacing or input responsiveness using matched runs.
Review a selected animation/component/diff for behavioral defects and usability costs; no implementation implied.
Inventory motion broadly and prepare a prioritized evidence-backed improvement plan; no source changes.
Find a few places where motion could improve feedback, orientation, or continuity; recommendations only.
Name or explain an effect from a description or reference; naming does not authorize implementation.
